text: Kotiraawo mawɗo on wi'i: Ruttee ka ben mon, wi'anon mo: Ɓiɗɗo maa on wujjii, laamɗo Misra on maccinɗinirii mo lepte nguyka makko kan. Men humpitaa ma non si wanaa ko men anndi e huunde nde men seedorii yaltineede sariyaare laamɗo on ka doŋngal ɓiɗɗo maa on. Men anndaano o wujjay, si meɗen annduno ɗum, men ahodataano e maaɗa artirgol mo.
